annotations.title: Add a contact to a group

description: Add a contact or company to a group (creates a group membership). Identify the group by group_id (preferred) or group_name — not both. LACRM: CreateGroupMembership.

contact_id.description: The contact or company id (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

group_id.description: The group id (a long numeric Uid — always pass it as a string).

group_name.description: The group name, if you do not have its id.

name: lacrm_add_contact_to_group
title: Add a contact to a group
